name: Introductory Chemistry
summary: First contact with chemistry: matter, atoms, the periodic table, simple bonding, the mole and reactions, for learners with only high-school basics.

topics.name: What chemistry studies: matter, properties, physical vs chemical change
Measurement, SI units, significant figures and dimensional analysis
Classification of matter: elements, compounds, mixtures and separation methods
Atoms, subatomic particles, isotopes and atomic mass
The periodic table: groups, periods, metals, nonmetals and metalloids
Ions, ionic vs covalent compounds and chemical formulas
The mole, molar mass and Avogadro's number
Balancing chemical equations and classifying reactions (synthesis, decomposition, combustion, precipitation, acid-base, redox)
Stoichiometry: mole ratios, limiting reagent and percent yield
States of matter and the kinetic-molecular picture
Simple gas laws (Boyle, Charles, ideal gas law)
Solutions: solubility, concentration, molarity and dilution
Acids, bases, pH and neutralization basics
Energy in chemical change: exothermic vs endothermic processes
Introduction to nuclear chemistry: radioactivity and half-life
Chemistry in everyday life: household chemicals, food, fuels and materials
